instruction: GUI-only requirement: Complete the task entirely in the launched ZBrush graphical user interface. Do not open Command Prompt, PowerShell, Terminal, or any shell; do not run ZScript files, Python, macros, or other helper scripts/code that directly generates or edits the deliverable files. Use only ZBrush native GUI tools, menus, brushes, and built-in export commands. Decimation Master to STL for 3D printing The opened `scene.obj` contains a bust-like ellipsoid SubTool named 'Bust' (0.8x1.0x0.9 BU, lat-lon 32x64 triangulated, with mild surface noise, ~4k triangles). Decimate it via ZBrush's Decimation Master plug-in to roughly half of the input triangle count (~2k tris), and export it as a binary STL file `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Bust.stl` that is watertight, all-triangle, and preserves the bust's overall shape. Requirements: - `C:\Users\user\Desktop\Bust.stl` exists and is parseable as STL. - Triangle count in [1500, 2500]. - All faces are triangles and non-degenerate (3 distinct vertices). - Mesh is watertight: every edge is shared by exactly 2 triangles (using quantized vertex identity). - Signed volume (via divergence theorem) differs from the input by less than 5%. - Bounding-box diagonal differs from the input by less than 5%.

command: import pyautogui, time; time.sleep(65); [pyautogui.press('enter') or time.sleep(3) for _ in range(10)]; time.sleep(5)
